subject: Begin broad web-design museum curriculum
body: Adopt dore-design/learning/web-design-curriculum-v1.md as a required long-running design-learning curriculum. The current repeated white/stone + gold-rule + giant-serif language is not an accepted style and must stop acting as a default. Read the curriculum, establish durable curriculum state and run the existing design evidence loop against deliberately diverse categories. Do not claim completion merely because old Storybook tests pass. This is an ongoing museum-like learning loop: broad exposure, decomposition, experiments, browser evidence, critique, durable learning, cross-breeding. New Westside convergence remains suspended until diversity gates are evidenced.
